g.text: Drama 3 · A100 80GB PCIe · cu129 / R550 · actual host conditions
Each point: one 1088-prompt run, same workload and CPU affinity; no saved audio. Solid stall lines: >0 ms.
Thermal conditions were not controlled; hardware panels document observed state, not a causal correction.
Lines connect observations only. Follow-up results remain separate from the original 17-run B1 table.
